title: Scripture and the Living Tradition

author.name: John Meyendorff
author.bio: Patristic scholar and historian of Byzantine Christianity.

shortDescription: How the Church Fathers read the Scriptures: not as an isolated dead text, but within the Eucharistic life of the Holy Spirit.
publicationInfo: Living Tradition: Orthodox Witness in the Contemporary World, SVS Press.

sections.title: The Church Preceding the Written Canon

blocks.text: The holy Scriptures did not fall from heaven as a bound volume; they were born from the living witness of the apostolic communities under the inspiration of Pentecost.
To separate the written text of Scripture from the ecclesial matrix in which it was recognized, codified, and proclaimed is to reduce a living revelation into a historical fossil.

chapters.title: The Spiritual Hermeneutic of the Fathers

sections.title: Christ as the Scope of All Scripture

blocks.text: From Origen to Chrysostom, the Fathers read both Testaments with Christ as their single, unifying horizon. Every psalm, prophecy, and patriarchal history pointed toward the Incarnation.
Literal interpretation served as the solid foundation, but spiritual contemplation (theoria) elevated the soul from the letter to the life-giving Spirit.
